## 2025: The State of Generative AI in the Enterprise

For all the fears of over-investment, AI is spreading across enterprises at a pace with no precedent in modern software history. Our data indicates companies spent **$37 billion** on generative AI in 2025, a **3.2x** year-over-year increase.

[Read more](https://menlovc.com/perspective/2025-the-state-of-generative-ai-in-the-enterprise/ "Read more") [Read more](https://menlovc.com/perspective/2025-the-state-of-generative-ai-in-the-enterprise/ "Read more")

## 2025: The State of AI in Healthcare

Long dismissed as a digital laggard that trailed years behind every major innovation wave, healthcare has flipped the script. The **$4.9T** industry is now deploying AI at **2.2x** the rate of the broader U.S. economy.

## 2025 Mid-Year LLM Market Update: Foundation Model Landscape

**A new enterprise LLM leader has emerged as usage and spend surge.** Foundation models are not just powering generative AI; they’re shaping the future of computing. As their capabilities and economics evolve, so will the systems, applications, and industries built on top of them.

## 2025: The State of Consumer AI

AI’s consumer tipping point has arrived. **61%** of American adults have used AI in the past six months, and nearly **one in five** rely on it every day. Scaled globally, that translates to **1.7–1.8B** people who have used AI tools, with **500–600M** engaging daily. This is no longer experimentation; it’s habit formation at an unprecedented scale.

[Read more](https://menlovc.com/perspective/2025-the-state-of-consumer-ai/ "Read more") [Read more](https://menlovc.com/perspective/2025-the-state-of-consumer-ai/ "Read more")

## Congratulations, Chime!

Chime ( **CHYM**) is trading on the Nasdaq after a 13-year journey to “unite everyday people to unlock financial progress.” Menlo Ventures wishes Chris, Ryan, and the entire team our heartiest congratulations for building a truly beloved product that helps millions of customers lead healthier financial lives.
